item.title: New lawsuits claim OpenAI execs put image ahead of safety in Canadian mass shooting
item.description: The suits say that recommendations to alert police about the alleged shooter were nixed by the OpenAI's global affairs team, led by veteran political strategist Chris Lehane. OpenAI denies the claims.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Whatever happened to ... children infected with HIV due to failures in healthcare?
item.description: For years, Pakistan has seen cases of children infected with HIV due to unsafe treatment in clinics and hospitals. A current outbreak numbers hundreds of cases. Why does this problem keep occurring?
item.content:encoded:

item.title: India's prime minister is wooing the Gen Z while cracking down on them
item.description: Over two months, protesters, most who appeared to be digitally-savvy GenZ, used social media to organize. Government's efforts to respond spotlight how the ruling party appears to be playing catch-up.

item.title: ICE says it now has enough body cameras. And, Congress averts shutdown before midterms
item.description: Immigration and Customs Enforcement says it now has enough body cameras to equip all of its agents. And, Congress votes to fund the government, averting a government shutdown ahead of the midterms.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Israel bars U.S. citizens over criticism and ties to Palestinian activists, lawyers say
item.description: Travelers from the U.S. and other nations are denied entry to Israel after interrogations about their links to Palestinians, plans to visit the occupied West Bank and opinions of Israel, lawyers say.

item.title: ICE detainee dies just hours after he was admitted into detention
item.description: Lianyong Wei's death marks the 57th death of an immigrant detainee held in the care of the government since the start of President Trump's second term. Twenty-four of those have occurred since Jan. 1.

item.title: He died of 'natural causes.' But his mother says she knows what killed him: heat
item.description: When Arizona counts heat-related deaths, Adam Willson isn't included. His story shows how thousands of heat deaths can go uncounted every year in the United States.

item.title: Germany blames Russia for last month's attempted drone attack at Leipzig airport
item.description: The German government blamed Russia for an attempted attack at Leipzig airport last month using a drone laden with explosives. It announced that it would shut down a Russian consulate among measures.
